description: NOTUS reports that Cait Conley pledged not to accept corporate PAC money, yet nearly half of the contributions she received from federal PACs came from committees that took corporate PAC money. Conley’s campaign did not respond to the outlet’s request for comment.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lawler for Congress, Inc
title: SHOCKING REPORT: CAIT CONLEY TOOK TENS OF THOUSANDS FROM COMMITTEES FUNDED BY CORPORATE PACS, DESPITE HER PLEDGE TO REFUSE CORPORATE CASH - Mike Lawler for Congress
